title: Minute log return
explanation: Returns in basis points; one basis point is 0.01 percent.
caption: Equation (1). Minute log return.

title: Cumulative event-time response
explanation: A bar is labelled by its start minute. The close of bar h−1 is the horizon-h endpoint.
caption: Equation (2). Cumulative event-time response.

title: Rate changes in basis points
explanation: USMPD rate changes are supplied in percentage points.
caption: Equation (3). Rate changes in basis points.

title: Frozen rate-surprise factor
explanation: The loading vector, centre and scale are fitted on 39 development statements, then held fixed.
caption: Equation (4). Frozen rate-surprise factor.

title: Unrestricted horizon regression
explanation: Separate OLS regressions estimate a response association at each of 20 horizons.
caption: Equation (5). Unrestricted horizon regression.

title: Incremental response coefficient
explanation: Differences describe when the estimated cumulative association changes.
caption: Equation (6). Incremental response coefficient.

title: Predeclared lagged-response estimand
explanation: Estimate directly by regressing Y(20)−Y(5) on the same event-level surprise.
caption: Equation (7). Predeclared lagged-response estimand.

title: Conditional adjustment curve
explanation: A is a signed long-run model amplitude; f is the first-minute fraction and k is a rate per minute.
caption: Equation (8). Conditional adjustment curve.

title: Time to a target adjustment fraction
explanation: This is conditional on the monotone model; it is not a model-free time at which all information is incorporated.
caption: Equation (9). Time to a target adjustment fraction.

title: Half-life of the remaining adjustment
explanation: The remaining-gap half-life differs from time to 50 percent of total adjustment when f is nonzero.
caption: Equation (10). Half-life of the remaining adjustment.

title: HC3 covariance estimator
explanation: Here x superscript R is a regression row, distinct from the rate-input vector; ℓ is OLS leverage.
caption: Equation (11). HC3 covariance estimator.

title: Event-path wild-bootstrap draw
explanation: One sign per event is shared across all horizons, retaining within-event path dependence.
caption: Equation (12). Event-path wild-bootstrap draw.

title: Simultaneous response band
explanation: The critical value is the 95th percentile of the bootstrap maximum absolute studentised coefficient error across the 20 horizons.
caption: Equation (13). Simultaneous response band.

title: Realised variance in an event window
explanation: Measured in squared basis points and compared with the selected matched weekday.
caption: Equation (14). Realised variance in an event window.

title: Paired prediction-loss difference
explanation: Negative values favour the frozen surprise model over the development-mean baseline.
caption: Equation (15). Paired prediction-loss difference.

title: Predictive lead–lag association
explanation: Event fixed effects and own-return lags precede exploratory tests of the three cross-series lags; event-cluster uncertainty is approximate.
caption: Equation (16). Predictive lead–lag association.

title: Monte Carlo standard error
explanation: M is the number of independent simulation replications; simulation performance estimates have their own uncertainty.
caption: Equation (17). Monte Carlo standard error.

title: Plateau reporting diagnostic
explanation: The margin depends on an estimated terminal response; this is a reporting heuristic, not a validated formal equivalence test.
caption: Equation (18). Plateau reporting diagnostic.

title: Audited source-clock mapping
explanation: dEurope is one hour during European summer time and zero otherwise. A02 records the evidence, scope and retrospective nature of this correction.
caption: Equation (19). Audited source-clock mapping.
